builds.opis: Gotowy rajdowy build Melee Huntera (Survival / Melee): Superior Strikes (-1s CD na Raptor Strike), Savage Strikes (+20% Crit), Surefooted (+3% Hit), Killer Instinct (+3% Crit), Lightning Reflexes (+15% Agility) oraz Lethal i Mortal Shots.
builds.opisEn: Raid-ready Melee Survival Hunter build (0/18/33): Superior Strikes, Savage Strikes (+20% Raptor Crit), Killer Instinct, 15% Agility Lightning Reflexes, Counterattack, combined with Lethal Shots and Mortal Shots.
kolejnosc: Superior Strikes 5/5 (-1s CD na Raptor Strike i Mongoose Bite)
Savage Strikes 2/2 (+20% szansy na krytyk Raptor Strike i Mongoose Bite)
Deflection 5/5 (+5% Parry aktywujące Mongoose Bite i Counterattack)
Killer Instinct 3/3 (+3% Crit na wszystkie ataki)
Improved Slaying 3/3 (+3% dmg i crit dmg)
W Marksmanship: Efficiency 5, Lethal Shots 5, Aimed Shot 1, Mortal Shots 5, Barrage 2
kolejnoscEn: Superior Strikes 5/5 (-1s cooldown on Raptor Strike)
Savage Strikes 2/2 (+20% crit chance on Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite)
Surefooted 3/3 (+3% Hit) and Killer Instinct 3/3 (+3% Crit)
Marksmanship: Lethal Shots 5/5 and Mortal Shots 5/5
uwagi: Optymalny z bronią 2H (Polearm, Dwuręczny Topór lub Miecz) albo Dual Wield.
Współgra doskonale z petem Kot (+10% dmg) lub Wąż Wiatru (Lightning Breath).
uwagiEn: Best utilized with 2H Polearm / 2H Axe / 2H Sword or Dual Wield.
Pairs exceptionally well with Cat (+10% dmg) or Wind Serpent.
